## Original source pin and independent test

The fixed original 65,536-byte synthetic source is SHA256 `fe3f6f1adb2eb15832bd5d5fd59c2c97bc77b581c5c60f54b768545c756b38c4`, retained 11 published 555×555 RGB images (32 ordinary QR symbols) in coordinator hosted CI [38735582094](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38735582094), Git commit `a3e86a169ee9d45d64cd83973919e760ce7e65d9`; two source GitHub artifact IDs Ubuntu 11973675852 and Windows 11974420144. Seat2 will **download these published artifacts**; won't regenerate the original QR source. Independent image decode library is ZXing-C++, never coordinator ZBar/pyzbar.

### Hypothesis A: intensity cannot authenticate 27 ordered rainbow addresses

For the finite ordered test universe `(r,g,b) in {0,1,2}^3` — **27 logical trit addresses, NOT 27 physically separated spectral bands** — define exact Fourier intensities `(S²,Q,Q)`, `S=r+g+b`, `Q=r²+g²+b²-rg-rb-gb` and the ordered integer address `9*r+3*g+b`. The full ordered 3-channel tuple and `P=I-J/3` numerator differences plus separately retained sum are invertible; intensity-only signatures aren't. Enumerate all 702 directed distinct source→candidate substitutions, count collisions under raw `(S²,Q,Q)` and normalized rational distribution (for norm0, a unique explicit `UNDEFINED` hold), and verify the results independently. Prior analysis predicts **10 raw classes (including zero), 7 normalized classes (including undefined zero)**, with 66 directed false-color collisions under raw intensity and 104 under normalized intensity. Must confirm or flag a falsification. At fixed `wave=7,address=13`, the deterministic Fourier pseudoroute cannot distinguish raw signature-equivalent inputs; show all 66 raw collisions **pass intensity-only** but all fail ordered `sector` binding.

### Hypothesis B: Fischer-indexed QR transport preserves **payload order**, not **RGB channel ownership**

For each of the **11 published original RGB images**, generate all 5 nonidentity permutations of its physical R/G/B planes (55 altered 555×555 images). **Read the altered pixels with ZXing-C++**, enforce each observed QR payload is strict base64 + valid 4-byte little-endian index; reconstruct the global original memory from original images plus one altered image. Because Fischer indices travel inside QR payloads, a channel-plane swap is expected to leave whole-file payload SHA **unchanged**: **55/55 original payload SHA passes despite wrong physical channel order**. This is an intentional falsification of any claim that the existing whole-file SHA *alone* binds R/G/B plane identity. DO NOT incorrectly claim QR reassembly or source cryptographic integrity is broken; the QR protocol says indexed order independence explicitly.

Now separately anchor **the expected (image index, physical plane label, Fischer index, raw QR chunk SHA) mapping** to the frozen original 11 images. Require all 55 modified images **fail** this *external* channel-assignment binding while 11/11 unchanged originals pass. Compare pixel hashes, demonstrate image file SHA may change for serialization, avoid dependence on PNG container bytes. If full-width image is resized/flattened such that ZXing stops decoding, label as decoder limitation not spoof accepted.

### Hypothesis C: credible origin is a trust-root problem

If attacker can rewrite both QR channels and expected mapping manifest/root, an unauthenticated SHA checksum of the manifest is insufficient for third-party authorship proof. Publish explicit `ORIGIN_NOT_AUTHENTICATED` even when digital pixel/source binding works. Do not call ordinary SHA a signature; no Ed25519 key, external notarization, blinded physical host or hardware optics.

Publish independent `SEAT2-ROUND3-RAINBOW-ORDER-PROVENANCE-V1` scientific JSON and `rainbow-order-cases.hbp` with a SHA sidecar; preserve measured 27 logical trit inputs, 55 actual rewritten image pixel tests and all failure/acceptance counts. Run Ubuntu/Windows Python3.11 using zxing-cpp==3.0.0 and Pillow==12.0.0, no GPUs, paid HuggingFace job or real camera. Proof requires **original QR reconstruction still exact for all 55 swaps and all 55 swaps rejected by explicit physical-plane->QR-index frozen binding**.
